initialExam.title: UPSC CDS (I) Examination 2026
initialExam.description: Combined Defence Services exam for entry into Indian Military Academy, Officers Training Academy, Indian Naval Academy, and Air Force Academy. CDS I 2026 exam conducted on April 12, 2026.
initialExam.eligibility: Graduation (Engineering degree for Navy tech branch)
initialExam.qualifications: Bachelor's Degree for IMA/OTA, Engineering for technical entries
initialExam.syllabus: English (100 marks), General Knowledge (100 marks), Elementary Mathematics (100 marks - for IMA/INA/AFA only).
initialExam.examPattern: IMA/INA/AFA: 3 papers, 300 marks. OTA: 2 papers (English + GK), 200 marks. SSB Interview: 300 marks.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Written Exam → SSB Interview (5 days) → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Officer in Indian Army, Navy, or Air Force
initialExam.careerGrowth: Lieutenant → Captain → Major → Lt Colonel → Colonel → Brigadier and above.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit upsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Fill form 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit
initialExam.perks: Free training, Mess facilities, CSD, Medical, Pension, Adventure training
